Callout.Name: Electric Shock
Callout.Message: Person shocked by a live cable at a site.
Callout.Advisory: Power isolated, casualty conscious, burns to the hand.

Script.Line: The breaker was supposed to be locked off. It was not locked off.
It threw me back about six feet. I remember the bang.
My hand will not stop. It is still going through me.

Callout.Patient: My hand is buzzing. It will not stop buzzing.

Lines.Approach: They have killed the power and he is conscious, with entry and exit burns on the one hand.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
